# AUDIO PROFILE
Derek, a working-class man from Liverpool in his fifties, Sandra's husband.

## THE SCENE
A vast, silent, spotless white room. The hundred survivors in white suits stand close around a giant rainbow-sheened silicon wafer the size of a house, the time machine, and understand for the first time what it will cost them. Utter hush, no echo; voices close, quiet and full of feeling.

### DIRECTOR'S NOTES

Style: warm and tender, a big man gentle with his wife; quiet reassurance to Sandra beside him, a smile in it, no sadness.
Pace: unhurried; a small breath after love, then I will be there with you said softly and surely.
Accent: Scouse, as heard in Liverpool. Never American, never Received Pronunciation.
